blocks.text: Har jandar ki zindagi ki kuch zaroortein hoti hain. Jandar yeh zaroortein doosre jandaron aur apne physical environment (be-jaan mahol, jaise hawa, paani, mitti) ke saath ta'alluq (interaction) ke zariye poori karta hai. Ecology woh ilm hai jo jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur mahol ke saath rishton ka mutala karta hai. Is chapter mein aap mahol ke bunyadi tasawwurat seekhenge, aur yeh bhi ke maadde (materials) aur tawanai (energy) mahol aur jandaron ke darmiyan kaise chakkar lagate aur muntaqil hote hain.

Zindagi kaise kaam karti hai, yeh samajhne ke liye humein un mukhtalif "levels" (darjon) ko dekhna hoga jin mein qudrati duniya tarteeb di gayi hai; har agla level pichhle se zyada pecheeda (complex) hai.

blocks.prompt: Ecology kis cheez ka mutala hai?
blocks.explanation: Jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur apne mahol (environment) ke saath rishton ka.

items: Jandar apni zaroortein doosre jandaron aur be-jaan mahol ke saath interaction se poori karte hain.
Ecology: jandaron ke aapas mein aur mahol ke saath rishton ka mutala.
Qudrati duniya barhti pecheedgi wale levels mein tarteeb di gayi hai.
